footage.title: 1 · Footage
footage.none_picked: Choose the folder with your clips. Subfolders are included.
footage.keep_open: Please keep this tab open. After a reload, choose the folder again and it continues with the next clip.
footage.telemetry_note: GoPro telemetry and DJI flight data (.SRT) are uploaded too.
footage.unsupported_head: {n} clips cannot be decoded by this browser. They will not be used.
footage.hint.hevc: HEVC (H.265) can usually be decoded by Safari on a Mac and by Chrome or Edge on Windows and macOS. Chrome on Linux needs hardware decoding.
footage.hint.container: Containers like MTS, AVI or MXF cannot be read by any browser. Convert those clips to MP4 first (for example with ffmpeg -c copy).
footage.hint.other: Try a current Chrome, Edge or Safari.
footage.browser.no_webcodecs: This browser cannot transcode video (WebCodecs is missing). Please use a current Chrome, Edge or Safari.
footage.browser.no_avc: This browser cannot encode H.264 video. Please use a current Chrome, Edge or Safari.
footage.browser.no_opfs: This browser cannot store files temporarily (private window?). Please use a normal window of Chrome, Edge or Safari.
footage.browser.no_aac: This browser cannot encode AAC sound. Clips whose sound is already AAC at 48 kHz still work; other clips are reported as failed.
project.delete_lead: Deletes all data of this project on the server: copies, metadata, cuts and comments. Your originals are not touched.
project.delete_confirm: Type the project name “{name}” to confirm
project.delete_mismatch: The name does not match; nothing was deleted.

footage.analysis.idle: Starts as soon as the first clips are uploaded.
footage.analysis.waiting: Waiting for more clips before the next analysis run …
